method: Independent file-by-file review of all 114 assigned files: all 38 deploy Python/shell sources, all 34 assigned tests/probes/tooling tests, scripts/CI and repository configurations, all assigned documentation and all 20 feature-evidence files. Long outputs were reread in bounded chunks. Traced privilege/ownership/path and resource bounds; release/provider/control/configuration/HTTPS transactions and failure recovery; isolated dependency preparation/import; workspace filesystem/Git/index/worktree races and receipts; test-selection, source snapshot, release scanning and three-round audit gate. Compared documentation and feature assertions with current implementation and explicit acceptance boundaries. The large pnpm lock was completely parsed by a new independent strict YAML-subset parser and every importer, integrity, package/snapshot edge, reachability and override checked. The capability inventory was structurally traversed in full, every one of 178 method rows and every distinct assessment across 50 evidence groups and 15 additional workflows was read, and all 674 reference occurrences independently SHA-256 checked. Historical audit references were treated only as opaque hash bindings; no earlier audit/fix conclusions, sibling implementation or Git history were inspected or used. New official targeted tests supplemented static review; prior feature runs were not counted as current validation.

validations.note: Includes current gateway-ledger DDL compatibility, retired-operation preservation, pending/not_sent and dispatching/unknown recovery and clearing activityUncertain after stop-confirmed recovery; first-install/restart, spool and control/HTTPS/preflight boundaries.

Opaque historical report bytes were hashed only to verify the current inventory references; their findings or acceptance conclusions were not read or reused. Current full method classifications, evidence-group assessments and limits were reviewed independently.

validations.conclusion: Manager activate/restart/repair confirm both gateway and worker stopped before recovering the gateway-owned journal; pending receipts become not_sent, dispatching receipts become unknown and activityUncertain clears. Unknown receipts and retired-operation fences remain. Provider-only restart does not claim both-service recovery.

validations.note: Uses only current worktree/index inventory; no Git history.

limitations.details: Full Windows/Linux suites, Linux root/systemd ownership and UID isolation acceptance, namespaces/cgroups/loop mounts, real helper subprocess cleanup, disposable-instance install/update/rollback/control/configuration/HTTPS acceptance and reboot recovery remain behind the unchanged-source audit gate. This is an execution boundary, not an unreviewed code scope.

Every listed source was statically reviewed; only the 14 explicitly selected files were executed in this round. No selected test was skipped. Root/Linux probes, remaining platform fixtures and the standalone vision stdio probe were not launched.

No SSH, online instance modification, public TLS issuance, Authelia login, personal credentials, paid inference, external MCP, real OAuth/login/pairing, AWS, outbound email/credit consumption, cloud task or remote publication was performed.

Feature artifacts are point-in-time evidence with their own explicit stale-source/platform/mock/external-service limits. Their prior runs, screenshots and Linux observations are not claimed as executions or acceptance of the frozen round10 snapshot. Hash verification establishes byte binding, not behavioral correctness.

Pinned declarations, archive/integrity enforcement, dependency graph, overrides and isolation code were reviewed; this round did not redownload upstream toolchains, query live advisories or perform network dependency fetch/build. Local targeted execution used Node v24.15.0, while production toolchain pin is v24.22.1.

No findings means no independently substantiated actionable defect within the fully inspected assigned scope. It does not prove arbitrary race schedules or external system behavior absent the deferred real-platform acceptance.
